issues.quote: It had stopped. That is all I know of it. It stopped with its master.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator, the death's location, or the stopping of any clock.
issues.misreading: A solver could read 'It stopped with its master' as placing Aurèle's death in the atelier and fixing it to the moment the regulator stopped, which gives a time and whereabouts the sheet does not provide.
